About the Risk & Analytics Team: The Risk & Analytics (R&A) team makes crucial decisions that direct Affirm’s business strategy. We partner with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering, Capital Markets, and Commercial teams to grow Affirm responsibly by optimizing approval, conversion, losses, and profitability. Operating across the entire customer and merchant lifecycle, we tackle a diverse array of challenges from optimizing checkout conversion and mitigating fraud risk, to building scalable data foundations and enabling international growth. We analyze performance not just to report on it, but to determine where to invest resources for maximum impact through building tools, scalable data infrastructure, and analytical frameworks. We improve the analytics experience across Affirm by streamlining workflows and fostering a culture of learning and documentation. By taking ownership of the entire analytical lifecycle, from initial question to final business decision, we turn complex data and systems into clear, actionable signals that ensure Affirm grows efficiently and intelligently. Our Teams (Where You Might Sit): We are hiring multiple Early Career Analyst roles across Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization through this single job posting. Rather than interviewing for one specific team, candidates will go through a shared interview process designed to assess the core skills we look for across R&A. If selected, we will work with you to determine the best team match based on your interests, experience, strengths, and current business needs. You will have the opportunity to learn more about our teams and share your preferences as you move through the process. Potential team placements include: Point of Sale (POS): Optimize merchant and checkout performance to improve conversion, approvals, and unit economics across the purchase funnel. Direct to Consumer (DTC) / Card: Drive engagement, repeat usage, and lifecycle health across Affirm's app, web, and card experiences. Fraud: Prevent and reduce fraud losses across the customer journey while maintaining a frictionless user experience. Core Analytics: Build the quantitative research, machine learning models, performance monitoring, and scalable data foundations that enable fast, economically sound decisions. Servicing and Payments: Enhance the post-origination customer experience by analyzing repayment behavior, collections strategies, and operational efficiency. International Expansion: Build the measurement and decision foundations needed to sustainably launch and scale Affirm in new global markets. About the Role As an Early Career Analyst in Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization, you will join one of several analytical teams working across the customer and merchant lifecycle. While the specific problems you tackle will depend on your eventual team placement, all Analyst I roles share a common foundation: using data to understand business performance, identify opportunities, and help Affirm make better decisions. You will learn the fundamentals of consumer lending while executing scoped analytical work under the guidance of senior analysts and managers. You will leverage SQL, Python, and modern analytical tools to help optimize business strategies, monitor performance, and turn complex data into actionable insights. You are a thoughtful, driven individual eager to build a strong technical foundation, learn how to navigate exogenous market changes, and integrate modern AI tooling to solve hard problems efficiently. What You Will Do Derive Insights & Support Strategy: Leverage data analytics to uncover insights that help optimize product, risk, or growth strategies across geographies. Monitor Portfolio Health: Assist in tracking performance metrics, user behavior, and macroeconomic trends that impact business outcomes, flagging risks and anomalies to senior team members. Technical Execution: Write clean, working SQL and Python to build scalable reporting and partner with Engineering to support the deployment of machine learning and risk models. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Legal, and Compliance to understand evolving consumer lending regulations and market requirements, assisting in translating them into foundational data models and operational policies. Drive Launch Alignment: Support cross-functional discussions to ensure new product launches and market entries align with our operational capabilities and risk appetite. AI Fluency & Efficiency: Integrate AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, copilots) into your daily workflows to accelerate data mining and routine tasks, holding the line on verifying outputs. Familiarity with data mining, data visualization, and foundational statistical modeling. Basic understanding or deep curiosity about consumer lending regulations, fair lending principles, and how machine learning techniques apply to real-world business problems. role: Software Engineer, Internship - Sovereign AI Systems
description: A World-Changing Company Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more. The Role As a Software Engineer Intern on Sovereign AI Infrastructure, you will help build the systems that make AI agents useful, reliable, and governable in high-stakes operational environments. This is not a research-only internship. You’ll own a project with hands-on mentorship from experienced engineers, contributing to the systems that make production AI useful and trustworthy. That may mean working directly on agentic workflows, or on the layers they depend on: customer ontologies, context assembly, tool interfaces, agent identity or permissions, evaluations, and the core workflows that turn model outputs into real operational decisions. We are looking for interns with strong coding fundamentals and experience with AI systems. You should be excited to learn quickly, communicate clearly, and build systems where correctness, reliability, and customer trust matter. Contribute to infrastructure for agentic workflows, including tool use, context assembly, permissions, execution safety, observability, and debugging. Design and implement services, APIs, test harnesses, evaluation pipelines, or developer tools that make AI systems easier to operate. Work with engineers, product teams, and customer-facing teams to understand real operational problems and turn them into durable software. Debug issues across services, deployment systems, logs, configuration, permissions, and product behaviour. Write clear, maintainable code and participate in code review with a high bar for quality. Communicate your design decisions, tradeoffs, and results clearly to teammates.

Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the teams Stripe’s Controllership organization is responsible for the accurate and timely recording of Stripe’s business activities, the integrity of our financial reporting, and the scalable processes and controls that support our growth. We partner across Finance, Product, Engineering, Operations, Sales, Legal, Tax, Treasury, and Internal Audit to understand Stripe’s products and operations, resolve complex financial issues, and maintain a strong control environment. We are hiring four Controllership Interns, with one role on each of the following teams: Accounts Receivable (AR), Controls, Product Accounting, and Corporate Accounting. In any placement, you’ll work with experienced teammates and cross-functional partners on meaningful accounting, data, systems, controls, or process-improvement work. Accounts Receivable (AR) supports invoicing, collections, cash application, and related financial operations through scalable, accurate, and auditable processes. Controls supports Stripe’s internal-control environment by documenting and assessing processes, identifying risks, supporting control testing, and helping teams design sustainable improvements. Product Accounting supports Stripe’s products by understanding their financial-data flows, evaluating accounting implications, and developing scalable processes Corporate Accounting supports Stripe’s close, financial reporting, corporate accounting processes, and control environment What you’ll do We’re looking for graduate students who want to deliver outsized impact while accelerating their growth in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. You’ll apply classroom learning to important accounting and financial-data problems at an industry leader in fintech. You’ll support meaningful work with an impact on Stripe and its users, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders. Depending on your placement, you may: Support core Controllership activities based on your placement, including accounts receivable operations, monthly and quarterly close, financial reporting, product accounting, or internal controls Prepare or support journal entries, account reconciliations, supporting schedules, variance analysis, and other accounting deliverables Analyze large financial and operational datasets using Google Sheets, SQL, AI tools, or other systems to identify unusual activity, data-quality issues, reconciliation breaks, control gaps, or operational trends Support invoicing, collections, cash application, or related order-to-cash processes, where relevant to your placement Research accounting questions and prepare clear supporting documentation under the guidance of experienced accountants Assist with the design, documentation, testing, and improvement of accounting processes and internal controls Support financial reporting, management analysis, and internal or external audit requests Partner with stakeholders across Accounting, Finance, Product, Operations, Engineering, Sales, Legal, Tax, Treasury, and Internal Audit to understand business activities and resolve issues Drive continuous process improvement, standardization, simplification, automation, and reporting enhancements Complete and present a case study or scoped project to your team and the broader Controllership organization Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements Currently enrolled at an accredited university pursuing a master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Information Systems, Business, or a related field Coursework, a project, or practical experience demonstrating a foundational understanding of accounting principles and financial statements Strong knowledge of Google Workspace or Microsoft Office tools, including experience analyzing large datasets Experience using SQL to query, analyze, and validate data through coursework, projects, or practical work Excellent written and verbal communication and organizational skills Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to bring structure to ambiguous opportunities in a fast-moving environment A self-starter who can drive results, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines A solution-oriented mindset and enthusiasm for establishing best practices Ability to build strong, collaborative working relationships with business partners Preferred qualifications Coursework or experience in Intermediate Accounting, audit, technical accounting, information systems, or data analytics Experience with Python, data visualization, or dashboarding tools such as Power BI or Tableau Familiarity with an ERP, financial-reporting, or workflow-automation tool Experience using AI for financial analysis or process improvement Interest in payments, fintech, financial infrastructure, digital assets, or technology Experience documenting a process or presenting analytical findings

role: Junior Commercial Associate, Works in Progress
description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team Works in Progress is Stripe's magazine of new and underrated ideas to improve the world. We publish an eclectic mix of articles on policy, economics, business, technology, science, history, arts and culture, published online and in print. We have a fast-growing global audience, primarily in tech, finance and politics, and we are building out the team across editorial, design, operations and commercial. What you’ll do This is an entry-level commercial role for a recent graduate who is ambitious, organised and excited to learn quickly in a small, entrepreneurial team. You will work closely with the Director of Commercial and Audiovisual across the magazine’s commercial activity: advertising, subscriptions, events, marketing and partnerships. You will help keep commercial projects moving by conducting research, supporting outreach, maintaining pipelines and trackers, following up with prospective partners, and contributing to growth experiments. You will learn by doing: writing outbound emails, building target lists, preparing materials, tracking results, joining calls and following up consistently. It is a strong opportunity for someone who wants early exposure to senior commercial work and meaningful responsibility from the start of their career. Responsibilities Support the advertising sales process, including preparing rate cards, pitch decks, outreach and pipeline materials. Research and build target lists of potential advertisers, sponsors, agencies, founders, investors and partners. Draft clear, thoughtful outbound emails and follow-ups. Maintain accurate CRM records, commercial trackers and reporting. Support subscription growth through acquisition and retention ideas, and help measure their effectiveness. Help develop the events business, including sponsor research, partnership outreach and event planning support. Assist with early marketing and growth experiments across paid acquisition, referrals, partnerships, direct mail and audience development. Prepare decks, reports and briefing materials that help commercial conversations move forward. Join meetings and calls with clients, partners and agencies, taking notes and supporting follow-up. Help turn commercial ideas into clear proposals with pricing, positioning and next steps. Work across sales, marketing, events and subscriptions, adapting quickly as priorities evolve. Take on the practical, sometimes unglamorous work needed to help a small business grow. Who you are We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements Is a recent graduate, or has equivalent early-career experience. Is excited by commercial work and motivated by helping ideas turn into revenue. Is interested in sales, marketing, partnerships, media, events or business development. Is highly organised and comfortable managing lists, trackers and multiple follow-ups. Is numerate and confident using spreadsheets. Is a sharp, clear writer who can communicate professionally over email and in presentations. Is proactive, resilient and comfortable reaching out to people they do not know. Is curious, resourceful and willing to learn quickly. Enjoys working in a small team where everyone pitches in. Is comfortable with both high-profile opportunities and repetitive operational work, such as researching prospects and following up on outreach. Has an interest in media, publishing, technology, economics, policy or culture. Previous media or publishing experience is helpful but not required. Working at Works in Progress This role is based in London and requires working from the office every day. You will be part of a small, ambitious team that cares deeply about the magazine and its growth. In return, you will get a steep learning curve, close mentorship and the chance to contribute directly to building the commercial future of Works in Progress.

location: San Francisco, Seattle, New York City
description: About Stripe Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.7% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible. Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works. About the Team Our internship program is structured to provide interns with the opportunity to work on real projects that our customers urgently need. In this role you will be part of the Product Design team, which is made up of several groups that define, create, and deliver all user-facing aspects of Stripe’s product. Product Designers are strategic partners to Engineering and Product Management within their product area. In close collaboration with product teams, they shape user experiences, then translate them into high-quality designs that can be tested, shipped, and refined. Designers are responsible for building elegant, functional products that users love—and want to tell others about. What You'll Do As a Product Design Intern, you will focus on designing and building experiences that will be shipped to our users in production. You will contribute design iterations to ongoing project workstreams, tackling important projects to increase global commerce, and help shape brand new experiences. Our internship program is competitive and the expectations are high. Key responsibilities include: Work on a product design project with a product team, translating business ideas into real experience. Help craft thoughtful experiences that enable startups and large businesses to establish and manage their businesses. Apply problem-solving skills and human-centered approaches to address complex and ambiguous business and user problems. Develop and refine design solutions by partnering closely with other designers. Craft and prototype visually polished experiences to get user feedback. Partner closely with engineering to implement a feature/product from design to implementation, and get it in the hands of our users. Engage in group design critiques and collaborative design sessions to improve and receive feedback on your work. Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, including engineers, product managers, data scientists, and researchers, proactively seeking and incorporating feedback. Understand and advocate for our users, participating in the design process from early concepts to final delivery. Who You Are Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty. Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before. Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus. Minimum Requirements Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a design-related field, such as UX/UI, Interaction Design, Human Interface, Computer Science, HCI, or a related discipline. Some experience using computer programs to design, such as Figma/Canva. Demonstrated experience designing experiences and user flows. Strong understanding of user-centered design principles and best practices. Ability to learn unfamiliar systems, form an understanding through independent research, and effectively work with a mentor and teammates. Are a self-motivated problem solver committed to personal growth. Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Proven ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate work while applying rigorous critical thinking and professional judgement to review, refine, and validate all outputs. Ability to participate in a paid full-time internship between May–August, 2027. Preferred Qualifications (A bonus, not a requirement) Previous project, internship, or work experience in UX/UI design or related fields. Experience working with or conducting your own research, presenting results, and acting on those results. Experience with AI tools like Cursor, Lovable, V0, or any others. Strong knowledge in design craft and visual design. Intent to return to the degree program after the completion of the internship/co-op.
